ecosim-2dea74d9.description: EcoSIM at upstream commit 2dea74d9 — first non-FATES adapter-kit dogfood (BioCON test1_ex1)
ecosim-2dea74d9.param_files_extra_note: REFERENCE surfaces for documentation only -- no run reads these. Runs resolve A2MC_BASE_PARAM_FILE / _SECONDARY_ / _3 from the SITE CONFIG, which points at the m5199 project space. TWO deliberate discrepancies. (1) The PLANT surface: the primary param_file is the generic ds_input__pft_test__ex1.nc at 104 variables, and the extra listed first is the 121-variable surface named for THIS profile's own model commit 2dea74d9. The generic one omits 20 variables the production plant files carry, among them CNWL, which the seed names as an indirect driver of ECO_ET_col; with no node that curated edge was skipped silently. parse_param_surfaces merges first-file-wins, so the primary still supplies every name it has and the evolved surface adds only what the primary lacks. (2) The MICROBIAL surface: the microbial file indexed here is the 77-variable SPOSC-bearing copy, whereas EcoSIM_BioCON R3's production base (R3_28Para_Sobol_base/MicrobePars_SB1_b1.nc) has 76 variables with SPOSC ABSENT. The 77-var copy is indexed so SPOSC is documented and reachable in the graph; it is NOT evidence that R3 could vary SPOSC -- R3 demonstrably could not, which is a separate finding. See use_cases/EcoSIM_BioCON/memory/gained_knowledge/discoveries.json -> sposc_is_a_large_live_lever_and_the_r3_probe_was_unattributable.
ecosim-2dea74d9.notes: First adapter-kit non-FATES milestone. Uses the generic `adapter`/`model_commit_built`/`model_wiki_subdir` keys (not the FATES-specific fates_*/elm_* schema); version-association dispatches on `adapter`. expected_counts are null placeholders — filled from the first RAG build (T5) to arm the count-regression guard. Authoritative dataset paths live in models/ecosim/datasets.py (ModelDataset ecosim-2dea74d9); curated_yaml is the v0.1 ai-draft seed pending PI review.
ecosim-2dea74d9.legacy_note: Superseded 2026-10-15 by ecosim-cb243228 (PI): 323 commits and 282 Fortran files behind the binary EcoSIM_Lusignan R2 runs, and unable to hold six of R2's parameters, which 2dea74d9 does not read. Frozen: its seed is the 2026-10-15 copy models/ecosim/curated_seed_2dea74d9.yaml, so later seed edits for newer source cannot desynchronise this graph. Do not rebuild.

ecosim-cb243228.description: EcoSIM at cb243228, the binary EcoSIM_Lusignan R2 runs: jingtao-lbl/EcoSIM branch fix/r2-plant-balance = upstream-merged 09eb674a (PR 231 head, a2mc-anchor-0ffe5a06) + 9669b817 (plant balance counts root layer NK) + cb243228 (default-off switch conserve_root_clamp)
ecosim-cb243228.param_files_extra_note: The first three surfaces are files the model repository itself tracks at this commit, COMMITTED here (PI, 2026-10-15) so the profile rebuilds from this repository: byte copies of `git -C $A2MC_MODEL_PATH show cb243228:input_data/ecosim_pftpar_20260915.nc`, `...:input_data/MicrobePars.20260211.nc` and `...:examples/inputs/biocrust_hillslope/biocrust_hillslope_grid_20261001.nc`. The grid example is the one of the 18 tracked example grid files that carries all 104 names the source reads from the grid file (readimod.F90), including fAeroScalar, which the others lack. They supply names, descriptions, units and dimensions only; no run reads them, and which file a RUN reads comes from the site config. The last two are the 2dea74d9 profile's gitignored surfaces under Offline/, kept as FALLBACKS only (parse_param_surfaces merges first-file-wins): the shipped microbial file lacks SPOSC, which cb243228 reads only if present (NitroPars.F90:363-364), and the shipped plant file lacks RSRA, which cb243228 reads only in the uncalled ReadPlantTraitsNC (PlantInfoMod.F90:625), so the builder marks RSRA file_backed=false. Their name set equals the union of EcoSIM_Lusignan R2b's two parameter files (209 names; 207 from the shipped files, RSRA and SPOSC from the fallbacks).
ecosim-cb243228.param_file_categories_note: Default graph category for a surface's variables that the curated seed does not categorise (curated category wins, then this, then the parser's long_name keyword guess).
ecosim-cb243228.notes: Re-anchor of the EcoSIM knowledge base (PI, 2026-10-15): wiki regenerated by Workflow B against cb243228, output CDL extracted from source at cb243228 (649 fields), graph built from the same curated seed extended with the relations EcoSIM_Lusignan's R1/R1b/R2 work traced in source. Pins an unmerged fork branch deliberately: it is the binary the active round runs. Audit and log: memory/dev_logs_adapterkit/20261015a_*.

pflotran-157a26f7.description: PFLOTRAN at upstream commit 157a26f7 — the commit Jianwen Du's miniLEO build was compiled from
pflotran-157a26f7.notes: Second adapter-kit non-FATES milestone; uses the generic adapter/model_commit_built/model_wiki_subdir schema. Wiki is VALIDATED GREEN (2392/2392 citations, 123/123 routines; docs/a2mc_reference/wiki_source_validation_pflotran_157a26f7.md). param_file/output_cdl are NULL BY NATURE, not pending: PFLOTRAN's parameter surface is a text card deck and its outputs are fixed-width text + Tecplot, and both are PER-CASE files living outside this repo (the miniLEO bundle is 99 MB and belongs to the team's own repository). The build reads them via A2MC_PFLOTRAN_DECK / A2MC_PFLOTRAN_REFERENCE_MAS when present, and degrades to a curated-only graph when absent. curated_yaml_path now points at the v0.2 seed (2026-08-01): source-verified, adversarially re-verified by a 4-agent fan-out whose 13 hard errors are fixed, 231 resolving citations. NOT YET PI-REVIEWED -- promote curated_yaml_status to 'human' only after that review. Pinned to the team's build commit, NOT upstream master, which is 523 commits / a major version ahead (dev log 20260731c).
